text:
Jordan: Quick heads-up — Lumenix renewal call in 30. They're asking to move from hosted to Dedicated and want a 20% price hold for 12mo while they finish SOC2 gap remediation.
Nina: Current commit is 150k tokens/mo, month-to-month overage. They ran a 90-day POC and hit unpredictable bursts. They want predictable billing + data isolation.
Theo: From SE: Dedicated is fine, but we should size for 2x peak based on POC traces. Recommend explicit burst pool + scheduled scale windows. I'll attach MLE traces after the call.
Jordan: They also opened a security questionnaire (uploaded) asking about KMS key separation and tenant network isolation.
Kara (Security): Link to questionnaire: https://redwood.internal/sec/q/LMX-2025. I'll triage — KMS + VPC peering are supported on Dedicated plans but need documented config. ETA EOD Wednesday.
Priya: Deal Desk flags: Dedicated migration + price hold is a commercial exception. Anything >15% discount needs VP approval. Also multi-month commit required for Dedicated.
Ben (Finance): Payment terms note: 60-day Net reduces cash flow. Finance prefers Net 30 for commitments >$250k. If customer wants Net 60 we need CFO signoff. Revenue recognition: moving to dedicated reserve will be accounted as prepaid ARR if advance billed.
Jordan: Customer asks if overage can be converted into prepaid top-ups monthly instead of per-token billing. They want one invoice per month for a fixed spend band.
Priya: Proposed commercial structure: 12mo commit, 200k tokens/mo reserved (upgrade from 150k), quarterly burst pool of 300k tokens, fixed monthly invoice of $XX,XXX (modeled offline), overage capped and invoiced as top-up only after threshold, renewal discount 14%.
Theo: I'll provide tech note to justify lower overage: enable KV cache + request coalescing and warm start, should lower effective token count for common flows ~10%.
Kara: Security condition: we can grant dedicated KMS and private VPC but need signed DPA addendum and proof of tenancy separation. Legal will prepare.
Priya: I'll raise DD ticket: CODE DD-EXC-4728. Need modeled ARR, margin impact, and approval chain. @Ben can you run margin model for 14% discount + dedicated infra amortization?
Ben: Running model now. Quick flag — if we prebill 12mo and the customer asks Net 60, deferred revenue shapes change. Will send numbers within 24h.
Jordan: On call now; pushing customer to accept 12mo prepaid invoice option to satisfy finance. If they insist Net60, escalate to CFO.
Nina: Customer asked for proof of performance — can we offer a 2-week Dedicated pilot at reduced rate before full commit?
Priya: Pilot ok but needs limits: 2 weeks, non-production data only, capped tokens, signed pilot SOW. Any pilot discounts count toward the 12mo commit if converted.
Kara: Also: will run an internal risk review for the pilot. We require an evidence package post-pilot for SOC2 scope change.
Theo: I'll produce a short ops playbook: scaling windows, cache settings, and expected cost delta. ETA tomorrow AM.
Jordan: Post-call summary — customer interested; asks written proposal by Fri COB that includes: pricing, pilot terms, security addenda, and invoice cadence. I'm drafting now.
dealbot: ticket created DD-EXC-4728 by Priya
Priya: Routing to Deal Desk queue. Will include legal & finance reviewers. If VP approves 14% discount + pilot, we can proceed to amendment.
Ben: Margin deck posted to internal drive: https://redwood.internal/finance/lumenix/margin-v1
Jordan: Thanks team — will follow up with call notes and attach POC traces. :thumbsup:
